testedSource.basis: Canonical LF for text; exact binary assets. Identity is not semantic parity.

tests.skipExplanation: The offscreen WebView case has a passing Windows counterpart. Any workspace-tree link case listed as skipped requires Windows symbolic-link privilege; it is not counted as tested.

coveredChanges: OpenAI-compatible chat requests send a single-text user message as string content, matching @ai-sdk/openai-compatible 2.0.47; three stale test expectations updated to the integrated upstream-sourced contracts, one load-sensitive wait extended, a wire-shape test helper generalized, and the PSReadLine fallback test now resolves the same PowerShell as ShellService.
Native Cursor adapter is available as a user-requested extension; actual Cursor authentication/inference remains unverified.
Skills/slash context, provider HTTP options, file mutation notifications, partial question answers and mini-app message ownership follow the tested pinned contracts.
Actual ConPTY shell tests cover command-output boundaries, escaped input, watcher scripts and failed-command status.
Settings cards use validated provider provenance; pending human questions no longer show a contradictory stalled-stream notice.
Invalid conversation storage has visible recovery and explicit close/reload choices; failed save preflight leaves running work intact.
Search reports bounded omissions, supports nested filename filters and BOM-marked UTF16, and enforces the actual read budget.
Browser CDP subscriptions retain each consumer independently and retire safely during browser teardown.
Direct browser screenshots become real attachments and model-facing tool text is bounded while raw sandbox CDP remains available.
Provider-load errors no longer suppress independent cleanup; successful provider changes refresh open side-chat choices.

liveValidation.scope: DeepSeek custom definition read/Markdown (also exercises the single-text user string wire fix) and managed Codex tool turn. Main-window live DeepSeek input is covered by packaged-gui.json.

limits: The701-row scope and17331-function reference index remain preserved. Full semantic, line-by-line, pixel and identical reasoning parity is not established.
All live and packaged GUI claims remain historical until this exact new binary is separately exercised.
Single-instance focus IPC, native search gitignore/filter parity, persisted mini-app reopen, builtin skills and other scope-ledger gaps remain.
A storage change after successful close preflight can still make the post-cancel save fail; explicit recovery remains available. No automatic overwrite or recovery-copy is introduced.
Cursor actual login/inference and remote services without credentials remain unverified; synthetic tests establish only their stated contract.
The browser screenshot transport retains its2MiB UTF16 reply limit. The console-after-navigation allegation was not reproduced; no new fix is claimed.
Bounded read/search and context policies deliberately differ from source in documented ways; context characters are not exact token accounting.
Unmerged newer private Markdown/diff and lifecycle reviews remain separate from this cohort.
